symptoms: Irregular, water-soaked greasy lesions rapidly expanding on foliage
Pale yellow/chlorotic halo bordering dark necrotic lesions
White velvety sporulation on the underside of leaves in high humidity
Rapid browning and collapse of whole leaflets and stems
risk_factors: Cool, wet weather with temperatures between 15-22°C (60-72°F)
Prolonged relative humidity (>90%) and leaf wetness >8 hours
Overhead sprinkler irrigation wetting upper canopy
prevention: Plant certified disease-free seed and resistant cultivars (e.g. Mountain Magic, Defiant)
Ensure wide spacing (60-90 cm) for optimal canopy ventilation
Drip irrigate at soil line to keep leaves completely dry
Practice minimum 3-year crop rotation away from Solanaceae (potato, pepper)
recommended_actions: Prune and bag severely infected leaves immediately; do not compost
Apply protective copper octanoate or bio-fungicide (Bacillus subtilis) preventatively
Sanitize pruning shears with 70% isopropyl alcohol between plants
